work.title: Die Verwandlung / 变形记
work.author: Franz Kafka
work.edition: David Wyllie English translation, Project Gutenberg #5200

request: 接着聊《变形记》：为什么格里高尔变成虫以后，仍然首先担心上班迟到？请聚焦这个问题，不必重讲全书。

sources.title: Metamorphosis
sources.read_scope: Web reader continuous chapter I opening lines 30–117; no later chapters read. Bibliographic page also inspected.

story.statement: Gregor initially notices transformation, tries sleeping and moving, then worries about travel and work.

characters.statement: Gregor dislikes his job but ties leaving it to repayment of his parents' debt.
Fear of suspicion makes even reporting sickness problematic.

tone.statement: Routine scheduling against physical catastrophe produces comic unease.

ideas.statement: Work obligations remain an internal framework through which Gregor assesses himself.

highlights.statement: Close access to mundane calculation delays an adequate reckoning with transformed existence.

essay_plan.throughline: Correct the literal first-thought premise, explain debt and discipline, then show the formal effect.
sections: Focused reply connecting workplace fear, family obligation, habituated thought, and narrative incongruity.
essay_plan.context_reception_decision: Omit biography, reception, and later plot because the follow-up is narrowly about the opening.
